works.title: Natural Language Programming System: How to Build AI Agent Systems on Consumer Hardware
works.description: A comprehensive guide documenting the development and implementation of a complete natural language programming system for AI agents on consumer hardware (~$4,000 Mac Studio). Demonstrates that domain experts with strong writing skills—not formal software engineers—are optimally positioned to create AI programming systems. Chronicles the author's journey from total ignorance to completion in under 60 days while maintaining other responsibilities. Addresses installation, hardware architecture, system capabilities and limitations, and practical implementation for individuals and organizations deploying personal AI agents.
works.quote: Documents development and implementation of a complete natural language programming system for AI agents

works.title: Series Continuity Distillation Framework
works.description: A systematic methodology for managing and distilling multi-book trilogy outlines into lean continuity briefs. Reduces detailed chapter-by-chapter blueprints into essential information while preserving key character transformations, plot consequences, and thematic coherence across books. Designed as an optional integration step within an existing prose-refinement pipeline for writers managing complex multi-volume narratives. Enables the framework to understand lasting consequences and character evolution across series boundaries.
works.quote: I need to add an optional step in my Phase III prose refinement integration when the book I am working on is part of a multi-book series

works.title: Vajrayana Buddhism: A Personal Journey from Catholicism Through Skepticism to Embodied Practice
works.description: A personal spiritual memoir documenting the author's transformation from Catholic childhood rejection through atheism and New Age exploration to committed Vajrayana Buddhist practice. Explores how object meditation and embodied practice transcend intellectual knowledge, examining the psychology of belief systems, willful ignorance, and the role of practice in achieving clarity and liberation from suffering. Contrasts conceptual understanding with direct experience as the pathway to genuine transformation.
works.quote: A personal account of the author's spiritual journey from Catholic rejection through atheism and New Age exploration to Vajrayana Buddhist practice
